rows.title: Job scanner reads a posting's web addresses, e-mail domains and hashtags as missing keywords, and '+' writes them into Skills
rows.summary: Now: extractJobKeywords blanks a posting's URLs (scheme:// or www.), e-mail addresses, bare .com/.org/.gov/.edu hosts and hashtags (#LI-Remote, #hiring) before it reads words and phrases, so they are never JD keywords, missing keywords or '+' Skills; C#, F#, .NET, ASP.NET, Node.js, socket.io and CI/CD stay keywords.

rows.title: STAR Optimizer opened from an empty bullet (or empty line) puts its result at the end of the description and leaves the empty bullet printing a bare bullet
rows.summary: Now: opened with the caret in an empty bullet, empty paragraph or blank line between breaks, the optimizer remembers that spot (blankSpot) and Apply writes the result into it, so it stays in its own list (numbered stays numbered) and no empty bullet is left; with no caret in the field, or if the editor changed meanwhile, the result is still a new bullet at the end.

rows.title: ATS Check's fix notices name a section whose title was cleared by its internal type id, and the headings warning lists it as an empty quote
rows.summary: Now: atsHeadingLabel quotes a cleared section by its type's standard heading marked '(no heading)' in the std_headings warning and in the Standardize Headings, Put Job Title First and Grids notices, never as "experience" or "".
